shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls -a && ls src app 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -ril "proxy" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/ && sed -n 20,140p proxy.md; grep -n -i "runtime\|matcher.*default\|all paths\|every route" proxy.md | head -40

cd /workspace && (npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; curl -s -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3123/foo?bar=1"; sleep 2; cat /tmp/dev.log; pkill -f "next dev" ; true
cd /workspace && git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json; pgrep -f "next dev" || echo "no server running"
ps -o pid,cmd -p 351; pkill -f "next dev"; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && cat AGENTS.md | head -20
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && wc -l AGENTS.md
